limitations: Archived records are evidence of application completion; archive contains no independent sacct terminal accounting/usage report. Requested CPU/memory/walltime are not measured resource consumption.

Recorded tracked_or_untracked_changes is true. The five execution-source directories and requirements.txt/pyproject.toml have exact matching committed fingerprints; this does not prove global checkout cleanliness or identify unrelated changes.
Three intentionally excluded directories are pytest-cache, pytest-work, and Tower itself. No science scalar row, note, or recorded case is omitted.
stage.json is not one of the five sealed science files: source writes its final status after manifest/COMPLETED. Its exact bytes are preserved by upload inventory and verified by Tower artifact hash.
188 passes are archived CARC tests, not tests rerun in this review. This audit executes only stdlib read-only comparisons, never the experiment.

methodology.pairing: Same inputs.case_id; distinct method errors divided case-by-case before summary statistics. No ratio of unpaired error summaries.
methodology.resolution: Both outputs finite, in bounds, complete, reference accepted, and |error_A-error_B| > 2*recorded reference uncertainty; conditional on the operational uncertainty estimator, not a formal PDE certificate.
methodology.reference_scope: Same semidiscrete grid, three-level FP64 coupled RK4, full final refinement difference with roundoff floor; no spatial convergence claim.
methodology.replication_scope: 32 diagnostic cases, not 32 independent statistical parents. The crossed bank reuses one mixed field family; remote_3 and remote_5 are translations on a periodic homogeneous grid.
methodology.rollout_scope: Four five-step rollouts to final times 0.3 or 0.6; not long-time stability.
methodology.mean_scope: Logistic reaction changes the mean. The reported mean ablations address mean bias and spatial redistribution, not mass conservation.
methodology.ratio_uncertainty: Intervals propagate recorded operational error uncertainty; medians and extrema remain paired point estimates.

posthoc_tolerance_probe.scope: Descriptive post-hoc check; not a preregistered performance endpoint, matched-tolerance frontier, or tolerance certificate

conclusions: GL3 and GL5 additive corrections reduce accepted-reference L2 error against Strang in every one of 32 diagnostic cases.
Against ETDRK4, each additive correction has 23 resolved wins and 9 losses; every one of the three 2D cases favors ETDRK4.
Full GL3 retains median 2.7423 percent of paired Strang L2 error, at about 5.9 times the measured same-step CPU cost.
GL5 has almost unchanged median paired accuracy at about 23 percent more measured time than GL3; improvements are concentrated in a few cases.
Mean bias dominates Strang error, but both mean and spatial correction are needed for full GL3 accuracy.
Projection changes no reported scientific endpoint; capacity effects are small. This bank does not establish active bounding advantages.

next_experiment_proposal.status: not implemented or run by this review
priority: Fixed-horizon matched-tolerance comparisons with repeated warmed timings and equal coefficient caching opportunities.
Implement Parseval evaluation of the raw GL mean correction and verify parity with current GL3 mean_only before measuring speed.
Retain GL3/full, GL5 and ETDRK4 controls; use fresh 2D and amplitude-stress cases to assess missing higher-amplitude interactions.

parseval_mean_identity.definitions: v=u-mean(u); N=grid cell count; Pk=abs(FFT(v)[k])^2/N^2; lambda_k<=0 includes diffusion coefficient; D(s)=sum_k Pk*expm1(2*lambda_k*s)
parseval_mean_identity.scope: Algebraic mean of the existing raw GL quadratic correction in exact arithmetic; not the exact finite-amplitude flow mean or the mean after nonlinear bounding.

limitations: 32 cases are deterministic diagnostic conditions, not independent statistical parents; remote patterns are periodic translations.
References approximate the same semidiscrete equation; no continuum convergence or full FNO benchmark has been demonstrated.
Timing is one sequential CPU sample per method with uncached coefficients; no verified cold-cache, warm steady-state, or GPU performance claim.
All Strang cases already satisfy post-hoc L2 tolerance 0.002 at the tested endpoints; lower error does not establish useful cost-to-tolerance advantage.
Quadratic variation omits finite-amplitude higher interactions that may already contribute at h^3; adding quadrature nodes cannot remove that truncation.
